name: ServicePerTeam
summary: Gives each team sole responsibility for changing its own service, and ideally one service, so that autonomy is achieved with the fewest services rather than the most.

roles.name: ServicePerTeam
roles.summary: The service exactly one team may change. It is the rare claim in this catalogue that something outside the code can check — a `CODEOWNERS` file, or a year of history — and the rare one a codebase cannot break on its own: it is broken by a reorganisation nobody thought to tell the code about.
